schema: Gold ground-truth annotations. Anchors resolved in reference_text() (resolve=last→rfind; <<EOF>>=EOF). structure=repeating ⇒ expected_count+count_cue carry cardinality (A3 scores recall-of-count, not exact edges); exemplars anchor concrete instances. role=primary drives the rating; role=secondary is a grouping level reported but not rated. Offsets derived at eval time, never stored.

map_status: complete 2026-06-22: full materialized map = 9129 elements. Name lines and editorial apparatus are now split: `header` (1438 = 2 testament dividers + 73 canonical book names + 1363 chapter names) and `heading` (1434 = 73 book summaries + 1361 chapter arguments); legacy `chapter_heading` retired in this work's map. Book labels carry the clean ceremonial title only (run-on summaries split into `heading`). Still includes per-chapter `section` spans (1363) and the inline `footnotes` carve (1758) so `chapter` = verse content only (3039). Every char >=1 generic (body/volume/book/part/section) and >=1 specific mask-type; 100% two-layer. Structural masked set UNCHANGED by the reclassification (3040 spans / 600290 chars); the verse-number mask layer (union of the 35755 per-verse `C:V.` token spans from the lazy verses.jsonl index) is unioned on top at serve/verify time, so the live masked set is 37581 spans / 826357 chars.
